{{Quote|The divisions between the Faithful and the Faithless split every clan: members of the Ordos, Fetts, Kryzes, Awauds, Priests, Gedycs, and, yes, Vizslas, belonged to both sides in our struggle.|[[Tor Vizsla]]|<ref name="TBHC" />}}
'''Clan Priest''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan. Following the rise of the peaceful [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction in the aftermath of the [[Mandalorian Excision]], members of Clan Priest were divided in their support of the pacifist sect and the traditional [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans.<ref name="TBHC" />

When [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was [[Limb/Legends|hand]] picking [[Cuy'val Dar|training sergeants]] to instruct the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], among the seventy-five Mandalorians Fett chose was [[Dred Priest]]. Priest was a violent, brutal [[Gender/Legends|man]] who abused the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] in his charge under the belief that it would toughen them. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Dred Priest had joined the radical [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] group, together with his lover [[Isabet Reau]]. During an unexpected confrontation with fellow Mandalorian soldier [[Mij Gilamar]] in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], Priest was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Gilamar due to his Death Watch affiliations. His body was subsequently dumped into the [[Kelita River]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Priest was first alluded to with the appearance of Dred Priest in the novel ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[September 16]], [[2008]]. However, it was only with the [[2013]] release of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] reference book, ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', that Clan Priest truly entered ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].
